newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hotel Prop to buy stake in Indian hotel.
newsitem.headline: Hotel Prop to buy stake in Indian hotel.

text.p: Hotel Properties Ltd (HPL) said on Friday its subsidiary HPL Properties (West Asia) Pte Ltd had agreed to buy a 40 percent equity stake in Sri Tripurasundarai Hotels Ltd (STHL), a company incorporated in Madras, India.

It said in a statement it had signed a memorandum of understanding in which it would acquire and subscribe for four million shares in STHL at 10 rupees each at a premium of 12.50 rupees per share aggregrating to 90 million rupees.
The remaining 60 percent would be owned by Indian promoters, it said. The acquisition would make STHL an associated company of Hotel Properties.
It said STHL was established to develop and operate a mid-market hotel on a 5,734 square-metre freehold site in Madras for a total estimated cost of 360 million rupees.
The hotel is scheduled for completion in the third quarter of 1997.

The statement said HRC Holdings Pte Ltd, an HPL associated company, had entered into a memorandum of understanding with the promoters of STHL for its subsidiary HRC (India) Pte Ltd to acquire 51 percent equity capital of HRC Madras Pte Ltd.
HRC Madras has been established to develop and operate a Hard Rock Cafe in the hotel owned by STHL.
